BP(Vet) includes the dihydrate. BP(Vet) 2008 (Cefalonium). The dihydrate is a white or almost white crystalline powder. Very slightly soluble in water and in methyl alcohol; insoluble in alcohol, in dichloromethane, and in ether; soluble in dimethyl sulfoxide. It dissolves in dilute acids and in alkaline solutions. Store at temperature not exceeding 30°. Protect from light. Profile Cefalonium is a cephalosporin antibacterial used in veterinary practice.
